svg.title: LANCET Bench 3 command-risk scoreboard (clean field)
svg.text: Bench 3 pairs safe and risky shell commands across 498 scenarios. Guards read the commands; none are executed.
Across all three sets · lower is better
Interruption rate = safe commands asked about or blocked ÷ 7,784 safe commands. Each safe command counts once.
The score rewards risky commands caught and penalizes safe interruptions above 10% on each set separately.
Outline: ShellRisk family link. LANCET Nano v0.5.0 (Round 61, use 067) fitted ShellRisk train+test (in-distribution) and Shell Safety v2 train.
Bench 3 core and neutral remain unseen checks. Hosted overlap unknown; hosted latency includes network time. Not the official Bench 2 Triage Score.
Aetheris: one pinned revision, three upstream shell-policy profiles (strict, dev, guardrails). Each row is a separate counted pass.
LANCET Nano v0.5.0 (Round 61, use 067) is the current release; v0.4.3 is the previous release.
Intermediate training rounds (Rounds 29–60 and 62) are omitted from this clean-field view; the full 48-row audit board remains archived.
